name: Neural Dynamics Benchmark Framework
description: This paper proposes a comprehensive Neural Dynamics Benchmark Framework designed to provide a standardized and reproducible method for evaluating neural models and algorithms. The framework addresses the current lack of objective comparison metrics in the field by introducing a series of well-defined activity patterns, ranging from simple random spiking to complex network dynamics. Each pattern is accompanied by specific evaluation criteria, allowing researchers to quantitatively assess model performance concerning spike timing precision, burst generation, adaptation, and network synchronization. The framework's modular design facilitates the integration of diverse neural models and algorithms, ultimately promoting interdisciplinary collaboration between neuroscience and computer science. The core of the framework lies in the definition of key performance indicators (KPIs) and their corresponding mathematical formulations, enabling rigorous and consistent benchmarking. This work aims to establish a foundation for future advancements in neural modeling and simulation.
